summary: Tested the 'Cek Kunci Ongkir' feature. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass. POST /api/admin/shipping/verify-key returns 401 without a token and 403 for a customer. For admin it makes a real RajaOngkir call and returns key_status {state: valid, message, checked_at}, and checked_at moves forward. GET /api/admin/shipping-settings has exactly the keys configured, key_hint, enabled, default_weight_grams, origins and key_status, with no raw key, api_key_enc or _id. GET /api/shipping/status gives auto=true; after key_status.state was forced to 'invalid' in the DB it gives auto=false, and verify-key brings it back to valid / auto=true. Calling RajaOngkir directly with a fake key returns HTTP 400 {meta.message: 'Invalid Api key, key not found'}, which _classify maps to 'invalid'. Frontend at 375x667 on /admin/shipping: shows 'Tersimpan (••••<hint>)', the card ship-key-check, ship-key-state-valid 'Kunci valid' and 'Dicek <date>'. Tapping ship-key-verify (317x48) updated the check time from 08.35 to 08.37 with no error. With the state forced invalid, the screen shows ship-key-state-invalid 'Kunci tidak valid — ongkir memakai tarif manual'. Checkout for a TEST user then hid the destination search and showed manual rates (JNE 25k / J&T 24k / SiCepat 22k). Tapping 'Cek Kunci Sekarang' on the invalid screen set it back to valid, and checkout again showed co-dest search with the 'tarif standar' hint. Final state: key_status valid, /shipping/status auto=true. api_key_enc and key_hint were never changed, and save/remove were never pressed. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Both ignore key_status. While state=invalid, /shipping/status says auto=false, but /shipping/rates with destination_id 69243 still returned live 'auto' quotes (JNE 9000 / J&T 8000 / SiCepat 7500, possibly from the 30-min cache). /shipping/destinations also returned auto:true. In checkout, a buyer whose default saved address has a destination_id (feature from iteration 11) would still get auto rates and the destinations call would set autoShip back to true. This contradicts the admin badge 'ongkir memakai tarif manual'. With a really invalid key, RajaOngkir errors would fall back to manual anyway, so the impact is low.

Once _search or _one marks the state invalid or limited (e.g. a daily quota hit or a temporary 401), it never recovers on its own. Only the admin pressing 'Cek Kunci Sekarang' or saving a key resets it, so /shipping/status keeps auto=false (search hidden) even after the quota resets. Consider re-verifying when checked_at is older than N minutes, or setting the state to valid after any successful call.

action_items: Optional: make quote() and /shipping/destinations follow key_status.state=='invalid' (fall back to manual, auto:false) so they match /shipping/status and the admin badge.
Optional: let the 'invalid'/'limited' status recover on its own (re-verify on a TTL or after a successful API call).
critical_code_review_comments: _classify treats any error body containing 'limit' as quota exhausted. The request sends a 'limit' param, so an error that echoes that param (e.g. a 422 validation error) could be mislabelled 'limited'. Low risk.
verify_key catches every exception from httpx as 'unknown', which is fine. A 404 is treated as valid, which is OK because the search uses a fixed query.
The admin screen is 118 lines with testIDs on all interactive elements and touch targets of 48px or more. All styles use StyleSheet and all text is in Text components.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST users (test_iter12_*, test_ui12_*) plus 1 cart and welcome notifications. All were deleted by id. key_status.state was temporarily set to 'invalid' (only that field) and restored to valid with a real verify-key.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/test_pgs_iter12_key_check.py (-n 0). It forces key_status.state=invalid through pymongo and restores it with verify-key in a finally block and in the fixture teardown. Never touch api_key_enc or key_hint. Carts use owner 'user:<user_id>'. Checkout hides the destination search when /shipping/status auto=false.
